git history: projects/kittle-matter-chat/tests/Dockerfile and test.sh unchanged since 77cbd694; identical at 9766459f (v2 hosted source)
evidence: Frozen task/tests/Dockerfile (sha256 72998ab8...) is byte-identical to the frozen template tests/Dockerfile, and test.sh (bd682592...) is identical to the template. It pins every required component. Node comes from node:22-bookworm-slim, giving the Node 22 that integration.md:3 promises. Global npm installs pin @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281 (the REWARDKIT_JUDGE=claude-code CLI), @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 (playwright-mcp, used by judge.toml:19-20) and the app runtime express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1. pip installs harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7. Chromium is installed through the pinned MCP package's bundled Playwright CLI and symlinked to /usr/local/bin/chromium, which judge.toml passes as --executable-path. python3 comes from the python:3.12-slim base, used by restart_mcp.py (judge.toml:26-27) and probe_ready. procps and util-linux supply setpriv/setsid for test.sh. The runtime dependencies match the agent image: environment/Dockerfile installs express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 globally, the solution's package.json and server.js require only those two plus Node built-ins, and integration.md:3 tells the agent those are the globally available libraries via NODE_PATH, which test.sh sets. Runtime evidence: the hosted Harbor Oracle run of v2 (oracle-result.json, hashes verified, verifier_environment_mode=separate, exception_info=null, verifier 05:21-06:24) launched the app and graded all five dimensions (reward 0.9917). git shows tests/Dockerfile and test.sh are byte-identical at v2 source 9766459f and in this candidate, so this image's launch-and-grade ability was measured on these exact image inputs. That run used the v2 app and criteria, not v3, and a v3 full configured run is absent (raw-evidence-index scope). That gap is about workload and score, which other rows own; it does not affect this row's image-content claim. Adversarial checks: (1) An agent app that vendors other npm packages in /app/node_modules is copied with the /app artifact. test.sh allows node_modules symlinks only inside /app, and native addons built on the agent's bookworm Node 22 are ABI-compatible with the verifier's copied Node 22 on bookworm (python:3.12-slim). So a conforming alternative still launches. (2) A broken app cannot exploit the image, because test.sh zero-scores apps whose readiness probe fails. Unpinned apt packages (fonts, procps, util-linux) count only as a NOTE under check-dockerfiles.py and are template-controlled.
